product.olivetti-m60-3.summary: The 3-CPU version of the Linea 1 M60.
product.olivetti-m60-3.history: The Historical Archive dates the M60 to 1984 as a high-end system for organisations with more workstations. The Prato museum includes the M60 in its 1982 chronology.
product.olivetti-m60-3.architecture: CPU and cache used separate boards. The manual documents UC040/UC040A, UC041 cache and 3 CPU in this version.
product.olivetti-m60-3.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m60-3.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m60-3.archive: Associazione Archivio Storico Olivetti, L1: una nuova linea di sistemi informatici.
product.olivetti-m60-3.museum: Museo del Calcolatore di Prato, Olivetti L1 M40.
